summary: Publish the real Controller UI as an isolated read-only public demo with fictional inventory and Git-driven container updates

guide.reason: Document public demo login, fictional read-only limits, source access, automated publication, HTTPS proxy prerequisites and rollback.

api.reason: The separate demo adapter reuses existing Controller client read routes and response shapes with restricted session login/logout. It implements no real host operations and changes no production Controller/Core or peer contract. The hosting health probe is not a pool capability; the real API reference remains authoritative for the product, not executable demo capabilities.

roadmap.reason: Public product browsing does not implement or close a Core capability or phase acceptance gate.

state.reason: Immutable fictional fixtures and disposable signed sessions introduce no durable product state. Deployment image selection is website infrastructure metadata, not a real pool record. Controller/Core authority and replacement behavior remain unchanged.

verification.method: Execute focused backend/security/schema checks, typecheck and exact-image browser smoke, then exercise the installed container, private proxy, firewall, SSH, corresponding-source download, publication rollback and authorized reboot. Record actual outcomes and distinguish the still owner-controlled public DNS/TLS route and first post-push Gitea run in the linked report.
